senses.sense_definition: Geen adem meer kunnen halen of door gebrek aan zuurstof doden of sterven.

examples.text: Het giftige gas in de afgesloten ruimte <w>verstikte</w> de arme arbeiders binnen enkele minuten.

target_lang_translations.en: The toxic gas in the enclosed space <w>suffocated</w> the poor workers within minutes.

examples.text: Zonder snelle hulp van de arts zou de patiënt bijna <w>verstikken</w> in de rook.

target_lang_translations.en: Without quick help from the doctor, the patient would almost <w>suffocate</w> in the smoke.

target_lang_definitions.en: To be unable to breathe, or to die or kill due to a lack of oxygen.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to die or cause to die from lack of air
to kill by depriving of air

senses.sense_definition: Door te weinig vrijheid of bewegingsruimte niet meer optimaal kunnen leven, groeien of zich ontplooien.

examples.text: Zij was bang om te <w>verstikken</w> in een relatie waarin ze geen eigen keuzes meer mocht maken.

target_lang_translations.en: She was afraid of <w>suffocating</w> in a relationship where she was no longer allowed to make her own choices.

examples.text: De strenge regels op school kunnen de creativiteit van jonge kinderen volledig <w>verstikken</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The strict rules at school can completely <w>stifle</w> the creativity of young children.

target_lang_definitions.en: To no longer be able to live, grow, or develop optimally due to a lack of freedom or space.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to feel trapped or overwhelmed by a lack of freedom
to prevent something from growing or developing
to restrict someone's freedom or development
